OP - what you should know about SPAM at Voat:

Can I submit links to sites I operate?

Submitting only links to sites you operate (or are associated with), without submitting other, unrelated links, is considered spamming. If you submit niche content (for example gaming videos from your own YouTube channel), you should create your own subverse and submit the content only to that subverse. If majority of the links you submit are to sites you are associated with, your domains may be globally banned from Voat. To be on the safe side, if you submit 10 links to various subverses on Voat, at most 2 of the 10 submitted links may be to the sites you are associated with.

I've been seeing more articles in the last few months about bitcoin from media in the Southern Americas, like Venezuela, Mexico, and Brazil. We hear a lot about the Chinese, but I think bitcoin makes sense for people in these countries, as some of them have witnessed currency crises that many of us have not and they realize the value of something like bitcoin. Anyone remember the Peso crisis of the 90s? That was terrible, but that only strengthens the case of a peer-to-peer tool like bitcoin. In addition, when you have systems of price controls, wage controls, etc - economic policies that many of us in the West haven't seen in a while, bitcoin makes more sense and is one way in which one can subvert these.

Another note, bitcoin does *very well* against hyperinflation - look at Venezuela's example. It even outshines gold, though I like gold too.

**Daily Devotional**

**May 28**

*12 Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world; 13 Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; (Titus 2:12-13 KJV)*

Paul is telling us that the Grace of God teaches us to live a separated life for Christ, and that we should live a Holy life. Notice that the Grace of God teaches us, not the wrath of God. If we get hold of the Love and Grace of God, we will want to live for Him. We should not serve God out of fear (afraid), but out of love, for fear has torment (1 John 4:18), but love conquers all things. A born again Christian should want to serve God because of our love for Him, not our being afraid of Him. The only fear we should have of God is reverence, and not being afraid.

The blessed hope is the second coming of Christ, when Jesus comes again, and we get our new incorruptible bodies and know all things (1 Corinthians 13:12). Our spirit, if born again, is now the very Spirit of Jesus (Galatians 4:6), and has been made new and righteous now, but we will not get our souls and bodies changed until Jesus comes again. That truly is a blessed hope, as we will then live forever with Jesus and Father God in the new earth, in our new bodies, free from pain and corruption of any kind (Revelation 21:4). Boy, I can hardly wait for that Glorious day.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
